title: Synthetic reconciliation-candidate contract fixture
domain_of_validity: No claim is made about a physical quantum-gravity theory.

mathematical_objects.definition: A synthetic scalar disturbance on a fixed weak-field background.
A registered toy dispersion relation with one bounded correction parameter.
mathematical_objects.domain: Positive fixture frequencies and one finite correction parameter.

mathematical_objects.definition: The signed difference between corrected and baseline synthetic arrival times.
mathematical_objects.domain: Registered source-distance and frequency fixture grid.

assumptions.statement: The synthetic background remains within its registered weak-field regime.
assumptions.limitations: This declaration does not establish applicability to any observed astrophysical system.

assumptions.statement: The registered fixture propagation remains linear over the benchmark grid.
assumptions.limitations: Nonlinear or strong-field behavior remains outside the fixture scope.

limits.limiting_procedure: Set the bounded correction parameter exactly to zero.
limits.expected_behavior: The corrected dispersion and arrival-time shift reduce exactly to the registered baseline values.

limits.target_theory: Registered weak-field synthetic general-relativistic propagation baseline.
limits.limiting_procedure: Take the correction scale outside the registered fixture energy range while retaining the weak-field assumptions.
limits.expected_behavior: The fixture propagation speed and arrival time converge to the registered baseline within the frozen tolerance.

observables.definition: Signed corrected-minus-baseline arrival-time shift on the registered grid.
observables.validity_regime: The two registered fixture assumptions and frozen parameter grid.

proof_obligations.claim: The zero-correction fixture reduces exactly to the registered uncorrected propagation baseline.
proof_obligations.expected_witness: A canonical symbolic equality record over the frozen equation and substitution.
proof_obligations.adverse_control: A sign-flipped correction term must fail the registered equality record.
proof_obligations.limitations: Symbolic equality in this fixture is not evidence for a physical theory.

proof_obligations.claim: The registered large-scale limit converges to the weak-field baseline within the frozen tolerance.
proof_obligations.expected_witness: A monotone convergence record with exact grid, norm, unit, comparator, and tolerance.
proof_obligations.adverse_control: A nonconvergent planted sequence must fail the frozen comparator.
proof_obligations.limitations: Finite-grid convergence does not establish continuum convergence or physical correctness.

proof_obligations.claim: The nonzero correction fixture is distinguishable from the registered baseline only above the frozen resolution threshold.
proof_obligations.expected_witness: A registered pairwise prediction-separation result over the exact synthetic measurement model.
proof_obligations.adverse_control: An overlapping prediction pair must return not_distinguishable_by_this_design.
proof_obligations.limitations: Fixture distinguishability does not establish empirical adequacy or generalize beyond the registered grid.

non_predictions: The fixture does not predict a physical quantum-gravity scale.
The fixture does not address strong-field dynamics, cosmology, or particle interactions.
